results.criterion: Starting at `https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher`, with the V4 launcher displayed and the user signed in if prompted, select the **API Request Audit** card.

Selected the API request audit launcher card.
Observed the API request audit module.
results.reason: The launcher card opened the API Request Audit module.

results.criterion: After the first card selection, verify that the API Request Audit module is displayed on the `o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com` V4 host and no application load error is shown.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher route and saved its initial state.
Selected API Request Audit.
Confirmed the module title and loaded dashboard; no application load error was visible.
results.reason: The module loaded on the required V4 host without a visible application load error.

results.criterion: From the first API Request Audit module view, use the browser Back control and verify that the V4 launcher is displayed again.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher, then API Request Audit to establish the required first module view.
Used the Playwright browser Back control.
Confirmed the launcher content and exact launcher URL were restored.
results.reason: Browser Back returned to the V4 launcher.

results.criterion: From the restored V4 launcher, select the **API Request Audit** card a second time during the same browser session.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher route in the existing browser session.
Selected the API Request Audit card again after the prior launcher restoration.
Observed the module open.
results.reason: The second selection opened API Request Audit in the same browser session.

results.criterion: After the second card selection, verify that the API Request Audit module is displayed again on the `o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com` V4 host and no application load error is shown.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher and selected API Request Audit.
Confirmed the API request audit module title and dashboard content.
No application load error was visible.
results.reason: The second opening was displayed on the required V4 host without a visible application load error.

results.criterion: Across the two module openings, verify that the browser URLs identify the same V4 host and that the intermediate launcher view is visible between the openings.
steps_taken: Opened API Request Audit from the launcher and recorded the V4 module URL.
Used browser Back and captured the restored launcher between openings.
Selected API Request Audit a second time and recorded the second module URL.
Confirmed both module URLs used o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com.
results.reason: Both openings used the same V4 host, and the launcher was visibly restored between them.

results.criterion: During this flow, verify that no audit data is created or modified.
steps_taken: Repeated the launcher, first opening, Back, and second opening flow without using any create or edit control.
Inspected Playwright network requests for API Request Audit; the observed summary, filter, event, and ingestion-health calls were GET requests.
Backend persistence and whether automatic request auditing creates records could not be observed from the browser.
results.reason: The observed API calls were read-only GETs and no create/edit action was taken, but browser evidence cannot establish whether the backend automatically created audit records.

conciseReport: Verified that API Request Audit opened from the V4 launcher twice in the same browser session, with Browser Back returning to the launcher between openings. Both module URLs used the required V4 host, and no application load error was visible. The no-audit-data-change criterion remains unverified: observed API calls were GET requests, but backend audit persistence could not be observed.
reason: Testing completed. Six navigation and loading criteria passed; verification of backend audit-data persistence was inconclusive.
